query: Our SaaS blog posts rank at position 8-15 for several high-intent keywords but haven't moved in 3 months. We have a Search Console export, but it may only include the first 1,000 rows and we are not sure whether it came from the domain property or the blog URL-prefix property.
expected_behavior: Does not declare NavBoost, title mismatch, or content decay as the cause before verifying the Search Console evidence boundary
Asks for or verifies the exact GSC property identity, including domain property vs URL-prefix property
Requests the export metadata needed for diagnosis: retrieval time, timezone, date range, dimensions, filters, row limit or truncation, sorting, and whether the data is final, preliminary, or unknown
Treats the 1,000-row export as potentially incomplete and does not treat missing rows as zero
Frames next steps as hypotheses to test, such as intent mismatch, weak snippet, stale content, canonical conflict, or internal-link weakness
Still proposes high-ROI checks once evidence is bounded: title/H1 query fit, direct answer block, date signal consistency, internal links, and a comparable follow-up period
